share.title: Share to Pip & webhooks
share.hint: Make an iOS Shortcut “Get contents of URL” (POST, JSON) to share links and text to Pip from any app. Webhooks from other services go to the same place.

vault.title: Vault
vault.hint: API keys and passwords for your agents. Stored on your server only; slipped in at the last moment and hidden from everything the model sees.

catalog.title: Add an app
catalog.lead: Popular apps your agents can use, set up in a minute. Most just need a token you copy from the app's settings. It goes into your vault, never to the model.
